Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 1 998 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

STUD RUN TEE COUPLING ASSEMBLIES 

FOR OIL-HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for stud run tee coupling assemblies 
used in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Types 

2.1 Type A — The assemblies for taper stud run tee bodies for sizes up to and including 18 mm. 

2.2 Type B — The assemblies for parallel stud run tee bodies for size above 18 mm. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Assembly Details 

4.1 Type A — A taper male stud run tee coupling consists of ferrules as per IS : 8802-1978 'Ferrules 
for oil-hydraulic couplings' coupling nuts as per 15:8803-1978 'Coupling nuts for oil-hydraulic 
couplings' and taper male stud run tee body as per IS : 10453 (Part 1)-1983 'Taper male stud tee body 
(stud run): Part I Made from forging' or IS: 10453 (Part ll)-1983- 'Taper male stud tee body (stud run): 
Part II Made from bar stock' as agreed to between the manufacturer and user. 

4.2 T/pe B — A parallel male stud run tee coupling consists of ferrules as per IS: 8802-1978 
'Coupling nuts as per IS : 8803-1978 and parallel male stud run tee body as per IS : 10433 
(Part l)-1983 'Male stud tee body (stud run) : Part I Made from forging' or IS : 10433 (Part ll)-1983 
'Male stud tee body (stud run) : Part II Made from bar stock' as agreed to between manufacturer 
and user. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 For details not covered in this standard reference shall be made to IS : 8805 (Part 1)-1 978 
'General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems : Part I General'. 

6. Designation — A stud run tee coupling assembly Type A of light series L and 6 mm outside 
diameter of tube and conforming to this standard shall be designed as : 

Stud Run Tee Coupling A L6 IS : 10480 

7. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards: 

BS : 4368 Carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes 

Part I : 1972 Heavy series (metric) 

Part 3 : 1974 Light series (metric). British Standards Institution (BSI) 

DIN 2353:1966 Non-soldered taper bush type pipe unions, complete unions and survey. 
Deutsches Institutflir Normung (DIN).
